ratchet.schedule: For every original accepted position, from the first M30close after entry, at each normal newM30bar with a ready current forecast. Only completed-bar quote marks after actualentry update favorable peak; initialize peak at original entry price. Missing forecast leaves current/originalSL unchanged, with full trade retained.
ratchet.rule: directional_peak=max(previouspeak,direction*latestcompletedexitquote). proposed directionalSL=peak-predicted_q90*scale. It may install only strictly beyond entry executable price plus original entry spread in the profit direction, and strictly tighter than original/currentSL by at least one tick. No fixed Rcheckpoint, age threshold or altered hold. Round longSLdown/shortSLup to tick. Current executable quote must leave original legal broker stop/freeze distance; otherwise keep originalSL until a later normal decision.
ratchet.native: Use fresh executable quotes and original broker constraints, stable ticket-bound durable peak/SL/lastbar, ordinary SL modification/reconciliation/RC4shadow handling. Never lower original protective authority, misattribute an intentional ratchetSL to an old ARCstop transition, or block original management. Model/runtime faults are correction states without retry cap.
ratchet.proxy: Within each full original lifecycle keep original volume and occupancy. Advance all recorded M1quotes until originalnativeclose. Previously installedSL is evaluated before a new bar decision. At a new M30bar choose the first recorded M1opening no later thanD+120 for executable placement. NewSL must be outside the opening quote by at least0.01; native legal stops/freeze are later binding. Then check M1high/low with pessimistic gap fill min(open,SL)long/max(openAsk,SL)short. Original close within the same minute wins conservatively. No use of that minute high/low to choose its newSL.
ratchet.cash: Unchanged trades retain exact original actual/stressednet. Synthetic earlier exits use directionalpricePNL*sourcevolume plus min(0,originalactual-originalpricePNL), retaining originalnegativefinancing/transaction costs and no positive credit. Stress deducts full originalextra debit plus max(0,newrepresentativespread-entryspread)*volume plus newadversegap*volume. Original historical exit slippage is retained; changed actual native costs remain unknown. No freed-capacity/re-entry credit or historicPNLscaling proves compounding.
